question: As of 2022, which Indian musician has the most number of Oscar awards?
solution:
The correct answer is __A.R. Rahman.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Allah Rakha Rahman is an Indian film composer, record producer, singer, and, songwriter who works predominantly in Indian cinema.
 
• Rahman is now a Golden Globe® winner for "Best Original Soundtrack" for SLUMDOG MILLIONAIRE and has been nominated for three Oscars for the film, for best original score and two for best original songs.
 
• In 2010, the Indian government awarded him the Padma Bhushan, the nation's third-highest civilian award.
 
• Jai Ho" is a song composed by A. R. Rahman for the 2008 film Slumdog Millionaire.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Oscar Awards:

 
• They are considered the most prestigious and significant awards in the entertainment industry worldwide.
 
• It is given annually by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences (AMPAS).
 
• It consists of a golden statuette as a trophy officially called the "Academy Award of Merit", which depicts a knight rendered in the Art Deco style.
 
• The trophy was originally sculpted by George Stanley from a design sketch by Cedric Gibbons.
 
• It was first presented in 1929 at a private dinner hosted by Douglas Fairbanks.
 
• It was first broadcast by radio in 1930 and was televised in 1953 for the first time.
 
• It is the oldest worldwide entertainment awards ceremony.
 
• Since its inception, a total of 3,140 Oscar statuettes have been awarded.
